tailoring.headline: Solution Architect – Digital & E-Commerce Background | SAP Commerce Cloud Developer
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Works in a techno-functional role between business and IT.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Solution Architect – Digital & E-commerce
cover_en.hook: Toyota Motor Europe powers global mobility, and designing robust digital and e-commerce platforms for such a scale demands deep technical precision and robust architecture. With over 5 years of professional experience building, extending, and integrating enterprise e-commerce platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) for major clients including Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring proven hands-on expertise in aligning complex technical backends with enterprise business strategies.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: API & System Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and designed PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to ensure synchronized product catalogs across global channels.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Acted in a techno-functional role bridging business stakeholders and technical teams: analysed requirements, wrote user stories, and translated enterprise business needs into scalable SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Performance & Deployment
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) and led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed for enterprise platforms.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical expertise can support Toyota Motor Europe's digital vision.

tailoring.why_company: Toyota Motor Europe stands at the forefront of digital innovation and global mobility solutions. Contributing to your robust digital and e-commerce ecosystem allows me to apply my 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud expertise—building scalable integrations, optimizing architectures, and bridging business needs with technical delivery for complex global platforms.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud experience, robust Java/Spring development, and proven techno-functional integration skills to support Toyota Motor Europe's digital platforms.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and enterprise integration experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the Solution Architect role at Toyota Motor Europe. I hold a valid work permit and can start on 16.12.2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Solution Architect – Digital & E-commerce – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Solution Architect – Digital & E-commerce position at Toyota Motor Europe.

With over 5 years of enterprise experience building and integrating SAP Commerce Cloud platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong Java, Spring, REST API, and techno-functional expertise to your digital team.

I hold a valid German work permit and am available starting 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Toyota Motor Europe.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
